compositions.overview: This edition gives customers a say in substitutions and lets them book a month ahead. In the warehouse, pickers now confirm each item by scanning it, and can hand a run to a colleague mid-shift.

delivery-window-picker: Windows can be booked 28 days ahead instead of 14, so customers who plan a month ahead can book too.
A day with no free van says so and offers the next free day, where it used to show an empty calendar that looked like a fault.
saved-addresses: Renamed from "Saved addresses", which read as a settings screen, to match the label customers look for when ordering.

matters.delivery-window-picker: Orders booked a month ahead are the ones least likely to be cancelled.

new.text: Customers choose which substitutes they accept, line by line.
Pickers scan items, hand runs over mid-shift, and see each van's deadline.

changed.text: Deliveries can be booked 28 days ahead instead of 14.
